method: integral bipartite max-flow followed by min-cost max-flow on the reconstructed walking-distance matrix

scenarios.proof: All 43 possible one-extra-container placements were tested and were infeasible; this two-extra placement is feasible.
All 286 three-extra distributions and 8,363 relevant four-extra distributions were infeasible under the exact max-flow cuts; this five-extra placement is feasible.

limitations: Capacity is modeled in active address equivalents, not measured residual-waste mass or fill rate.
The exactness claim applies only to the fixed set of 43 analytical sites and the reconstructed distance matrix.
